anti_trude_vector: Two-Arcade Oblique Parallax Aperture & Sibylline Rat-Swallow Coexistence Diptych: oppressive subterranean leaden rat-tunnels with batlike umbrellas and cheese-pack scrambles parting like crystal and transparent gauze into soaring swallows, dragonflies, and sunlit cornfields strictly at an oblique two-arcade pause accompanied by an unforced pleasure gesture, snapping shut under any forced capture.
medium: Interactive 2D Canvas Oblique-Parallax Masonry & Crystal-Gauze Refraction Engine + Procedural Subterranean/Glass-Harmonica WebAudio

decades.label: I. First Consult
decades.ratSurface: Soot-slick stone drains, iron grates & tallow lanterns
decades.swallowHint: Whitewash eaves poised over raw summer wheat

decades.label: II. Return After Decades

stones.title: The Sibyl's Double Verdict
stones.inscription: Two cities share these walls: one of the rat, one of the swallow; decades alter both, yet the second remains forever the one about to free itself from the first.

stones.title: Leaden Subterranean Tunnels
stones.inscription: Single-file conduits of grey lead and sweating mortar where hurried steps echo without sky.

stones.title: Remains of Cheese & Ferocious Teeth
stones.inscription: Packs lunging through narrow drains to snatch contested crumbs from one another's bared teeth.

stones.title: Batlike Overcoats & Ribbed Umbrellas
stones.inscription: Ribbed black canopies and flapping wool coats folding citizens into nocturnal wings.

stones.title: Compact Walls & Damp Mold
stones.inscription: Opaque ashlar courses crusted with olive dampness that thicken whenever grasped by force.

stones.title: Oblique Perspective Between Two Arcades
stones.inscription: Where shadow thins along compact masonry and two colonnades align along a slant of thirty-three degrees.

stones.title: Crystal & Transparent Gauze
stones.inscription: At an unforced gesture made for sheer pleasure, lead and mold part abruptly like blown crystal and sheer gauze.

stones.title: Swallows, Dragonflies & Sunlit Cornfields
stones.inscription: Figures soaring in effortless arcs and darting iridescent wings above golden grain rippling in open wind.
